scope: Full 93-frame deployment of the step-2 rank-16 attention LoRA adapter
summary: The adapter-only checkpoint loaded into the 14B DROID model and completed a full-resolution 93-frame inference, establishing the training-to-deployment path.
evidence: The inference worker reports loading all 576 LoRA adapter tensors from iter_000000002.pt.
Pinned positive and negative T5 embeddings were used, so no per-rank T5 checkpoint load confounds the deployment test.
The generated H.264 video is 768x432, 16 fps, and 93 decoded frames with SHA-256 d1fd01fce306702845a5062e208018f766ae38f7ca061727dc18dbd7c10958c9.
The distributed process returned code 0 and result.json records status WORKING.
lessons: Adapter-only checkpoints with net-prefixed LoRA keys are compatible with the 93-frame inference injection path.
limitations: The adapter has only two optimizer steps, so this is deployment evidence and not evidence of quality improvement.
The development episode is not used for final held-out claims.
next_actions: Run formal 45-frame random-crop training and select periodic checkpoints only on the isolated validation episodes.
